//@version=5
indicator("uct-hma-macd-parity-v1", overlay=false)
hma20 = ta.hma(close, 20)
[macdLine, signalLine, histLine] = ta.macd(close, 12, 26, 9)
plot(hma20, title="hma20")
plot(macdLine, title="macdLine")
plot(signalLine, title="signalLine")
plot(histLine, title="histLine")

provenance.note: Captured via CSV export (Table view -> Download data) of a real SPY Daily chart with a live ta.hma(close,20)/ta.macd(close,12,26,9) indicator added, full double-precision floats. 2,031 real trading-day bars (2018-08-07..2026-09-04). MACD LINE ONLY (UCT's shipped macd(source,fastPeriod,slowPeriod) builtin exposes only this output). Internally fast_ema(12)-slow_ema(26), each an SMA-of-first-window-seeded exponential smoother (indicator_compute._ema_core) -- recursive/leaky, so it carries the SAME capture-window cold-start seed-convergence lag already documented for rsi/atr/ema/rma (divergences.json::recursive-smoother-cold-start-in-a-finite-capture), compounding TWO independent EMA seed errors (fast and slow).

_vendor_parity_warmup_bars_note: 210 is NOT the semantic period-warmup (that is 25 bars -- max(fast,slow)-1 -- the first index at which macd(close,12,26) is computable at all). It is a conservative round number past the empirically observed convergence point (last disagreeing index measured at 191 of 2,031) for the SAME general capture-window cold-start effect already documented for rsi/atr/ema/rma. Bars 210+ (1,821 of 2,031) never disagree again.
